ITEM 1 | Small cherry-sized tomatoes, bright red with glossy skin, some halved showing pale seed cavities, scattered across the bowl center; firm, juicy-looking, whole and cut pieces about 2-3 cm across | 110
ITEM 2 | Red bell pepper strips, bright glossy red, cut into flat wedges and strips about 4-6 cm long and 1 cm wide, slightly curved, firm with smooth skin and no char or browning | 60
ITEM 3 | Green bell pepper pieces, medium green with slightly darker edges, cut into flat strips and rings about 3-5 cm long, firm and smooth, lying among the red and yellow pieces | 45
ITEM 4 | Yellow-green pepper strips, pale lime-yellow, thin curved strips about 4-5 cm long and 0.8 cm wide, firm with a waxy sheen | 20
ITEM 5 | Thin orange carrot shreds or thin matchstick slivers, bright orange, a few pieces about 3-4 cm long, sparse and scattered near the top and bottom edges | 5
